verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring records and displays production LLM calls, and lets you compare models and prompts or replay past conversations. That is observational analysis of captured traces. Nothing in the evidence shows a playground where a developer can edit prompts, fill in variables and re-run them against live models. Because prompt iteration is a fair question for an LLM observability product, the axis applies, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
